messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: nova-orders hit pool timeouts at 10:40 UTC. Pool size is 10 and checkout was holding connections during payment calls.

messages.speaker: Elena Petrova
messages.content: We should release the connection before the external payment call. That is a code fix for later.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: For now raise DB_POOL_SIZE from 10 to 20. PostgreSQL max connections can handle it. Tracking in TKT-108.
